theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → let q := WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk W.toAffine; let h := q W.ψ₂; ∃ f : ℕ → W.toAffine.CoordinateRing, (f 0 = 0 ∧ f 1 = 1 ∧ f 2 = h ∧ f 3 = q (Polynomial.C W.Ψ₃) ∧ f 4 = h * q (Polynomial.C W.preΨ₄) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → f (2 * r + 1) = f (r + 2) * f r ^ 3 - f (r - 1) * f (r + 1) ^ 3) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 3 ≤ r → h * f (2 * r) = f r * (f (r + 2) * f (r - 1) ^ 2 - f (r - 2) * f (r + 1) ^ 2))) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ (x y : k) (hP : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), f n ∈ WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.XYIdeal W.toAffine x (Polynomial.C y) ↔ n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y hP = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Uses the coordinate-ring images of division polynomials, their recurrences, and accepted torsion-kernel facts to establish the specified initial values and torsion vanishing criterion.
